reproduction_target: Computational alignment + variant-calling + population-genetics pipeline for rhesus macaque MHC targeted-seq and whole-exome-seq data: Cutadapt trimming, BWA-MEM alignment to Mmul_10, SAMtools post-processing, GATK BQSR + HaplotypeCaller joint genotyping with explicit hard filters, Ensembl VEP annotation, then population-genetic analyses (scikit-allel heterozygosity/fROH, GCTA inbreeding, ADMIXTURE ancestry/K-scan, KING kinship, VCFtools Weir & Cockerham FST selection scans).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from biorxiv JATS Methods prose (v1 source XML). Authors state alignment/genotyping used 'existing bioinformatics pipelines' (SNPRC/WNPRC Genomics Services); MHC haplotypes obtained from WNPRC Genomics Services. NO code/scripts repository is published and there is NO code availability statement anywhere in the paper — only named third-party tools with (mostly) exact versions. Third-party tools are not read at line level (stage1). Wet-lab DNA-extraction/library-prep/sequencing steps counted in W, not verdicted (layer W / OOS for computational reproduction).

steps.label: Cutadapt v4.0 adapter/quality trimming of raw WES reads
BWA-MEM v0.7.17 alignment to Mmul_10 rhesus macaque reference assembly
SAMtools v1.21 post-processing of alignments (sort/dedup-class post-processing)
GATK v4.2.3.0 base quality score recalibration (BQSR)

GATK HaplotypeCaller v4.2.3 SNV calling + joint genotyping + explicit hard filters (QUAL<30, QD<2, SOR<3, FS<5, MQ<59, MQRankSum<-12.5, ReadPosRankSum<-8) + genotype refinement (GQ<30, DP<5) + >20% missingness filter
Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor (VEP) v110 variant annotation / consequence prediction
GCTA v1.94.1 (written 'GTCA' in prose) inbreeding coefficient from excess homozygosity (F_hom)
ADMIXTURE v1.3.0 supervised (Indian/Chinese mGAP references n=12/12) + unsupervised (K=2-5) ancestry analysis; PCA also run (tool unnamed)
kinship2 (R tool) pedigree-based pairwise kinship from Total Animal Care database — NO version pinned
KING v2.2.7 genetic pairwise kinship estimation from WES data
VCFtools Weir & Cockerham FST in 10,000 bp windows per birth cohort vs founding Brooks population (FST>0.075 ROI, 99.9th percentile) — NO version pinned

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 10/12 computational steps (version-pinned tools: Cutadapt 4.0, BWA-MEM 0.7.17, SAMtools 1.21, GATK 4.2.3.0/HaplotypeCaller 4.2.3, VEP 110, scikit-allel 0.20.3, GCTA 1.94.1, ADMIXTURE 1.3.0, KING 2.2.7). 2/12 steps cap at NI due to unpinned tool versions (kinship2, VCFtools). R★ not assignable at stage1. No env lockfile / container / conda spec claimed and NO code repository or code-availability statement exists, so exact pins are partial (no closure); even under stage2 no step exceeds RI without an executed environment capture — none is claimed to exist.
headline.coverage: 12 computational steps assessed from biorxiv v1 JATS Methods prose. Alignment/genotyping described as 'existing bioinformatics pipelines' with no published wrapper/repo. 3 wet-lab steps (DNA extraction, WES library prep+sequencing, MHC targeted deep sequencing) counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.missing: No environment lockfile, container, or conda/env spec. ~10 tools carry exact version pins in prose (partial capture, no closure of system libraries / transitive deps).
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a lockfile (conda-lock/pixi) or container digest pinning every tool plus its dependencies for a defined platform.

gaps.missing: Version numbers absent for the R kinship2 package and VCFtools — these steps cannot reach RI.
gaps.how_to_close: Record exact version (and build) for kinship2 and VCFtools in Methods or a versions table.

gaps.where: Intermediate analysis inputs (filtered VCFs, pedigree data)
gaps.missing: Only raw sequence reads are deposited (PRJNA810867). Filtered/joint-called VCFs, the pedigree from the Total Animal Care database, and per-animal group assignments (Table 1) are not deposited as reusable files; pedigree/animal data require a direct SNPRC data-intake request.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the processed VCF(s), sample/group sheet, and (where permissible) pedigree kinship inputs so downstream population-genetics steps can be re-run without SNPRC-internal data.

gaps.missing: Physical sequence-generation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W (3), not verdicted. Raw reads are deposited under BioProject PRJNA810867.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; the deposited raw reads are the reproducible entry point to the pipeline.
